methodology: Default mode: eight pairs, two fixtures and two repetitions per model, alternating AB/BA. Stateless follow-up: four pairs, one repetition per model/fixture, alternating order across fixtures. Full live agent tool flow. Fresh cache routing keys on every request; reported cached tokens retained. No retries or favorable-sample selection. Quality requires six exact fields and correct initial file order. Failed tasks remain in totals. Baseline uses pre-optimization modules within the same migrated workspace.

runtimeManifest.method: Same current workspace/dependencies in both bundles. Control restores four pre-optimization modules from HEAD:src, and reverts only projection wiring and recovery-denial metadata in current harness/policy. Migration and other user changes retained.
